emails.subject: Receipt for January king-cake slices
emails.body: Receipt #BW-010626-77: assorted king-cake slices and a small bag of coffee for pickup on January 6. Paid in full at the counter. Thank you for stopping in.

emails.subject: Chairs are back by your side gate
emails.body: Lucia, I put the two borrowed folding chairs back by your side gate this morning and wiped the feet. Thanks for letting me use them for my aunt's visit.
